name: 17325 · Gettysburg, PA
findings: ZIP 17325 (Gettysburg) has 162 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17325 (Gettysburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17325 (Gettysburg) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 85 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
